name: rounds-default
notes: Defaults for the continuous round mine (docs/13-ROUNDS.md). Addresses come from the chain profile; genesis is the next full hour at deployment. Upgrade, cooling, heat and overclock tables are the docs/03 values with per-shift cooling renamed per-round.
fundingNote: Pots are funded from the Pons trading tax on $RIG (3%, possibly 5%): the fee wallet swaps fees into the four Stock Tokens and calls RoundMine.fund(stock, amount, rounds), typically a day (24 rounds) at a time. Anyone may fund; the operator can unschedule rounds that have not started.
